description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your head sinks into your body and your face now peers out through the chest or stomach. Treat all Head hits as Body hits instead. When the Body is hit, roll 1d10; on a 10 the Head is hit. You can no longer wear a helmet and body armour has to be customised to allow you to see and breathe. Opponents cannot use the Pummel Weapon Quality against you. You cannot gain this mutation if you have the Elongated Limbs (Neck) Mutation. is mutation can only be received once.
